title: Find the Highest Score
instructions:
Write a function called `findMax` that takes an `IntArray` parameter called `scores` and returns an `Int`.

The function should return the largest value in the array. You can assume the array always has at least one element.

For example, `findMax(intArrayOf(45, 72, 38, 91, 55))` should return `91`.
hint: Start by setting a variable `max` to the first element (`scores[0]`). Then loop through the rest. If an element is bigger than `max`, update `max`.
